# Test fixtures

Real API responses (`inat_observations.json`, `gbif_occurrences.json`) with observer names removed.

`camera_trap_*.jpg` are real camera-trap frames from **Caltech Camera Traps**, via LILA BC
(<https://lila.science/datasets/caltech-camera-traps>), downscaled to 800 px wide. Licensed under
the Community Data License Agreement, permissive variant (CDLA-Permissive-1.0), which requires
attribution: *Beery et al., Recognition in Terra Incognita, ECCV 2018.* `camera_traps.json` holds
each frame's human-drawn ground-truth boxes.
